channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: BOOK OF HOURS: HOUSE OF LIGHT
item.description: A story-focused expansion for narrative crafting RPG BOOK OF HOURS. Explore visitors and their stories in much greater depth. Host exotic feasts and sophisticated soirées. And in your own quiet way, shape the genesis of the controversial Lighthouse Institute.

item.title: Dealer's Life 2
item.description: Your favorite pawn shop experience is finally getting a sequel! Haggle like your life depends on it in this funny tycoon game. You never know WHAT is gonna stumble through that door!

item.title: Dungeons 4
item.description: The Absolute Evil and its trusted *cough* servant, the Dark Elf Thalya, return in Dungeons 4 after the events of its fabulous predecessor to bring about their triumph over the forces of good once more.

item.title: Empyrion - Galactic Survival
item.description: Build and explore in a true space sandbox survival adventure. Construct mighty capital vessels, sprawling planetary settlements, and vast space stations in your galactic journey to discover the mysteries of Empyrion!

item.title: Go-Go Town!
item.description: Step into the role of a hands-on mayor and build your town from the ground up. Plan neighborhoods, automate logistics, and grow your community—all while juggling workers, infrastructure, and day-to-day chaos to create your dream town. Play solo for total control, or bring friends for co-op mayhem.

item.title: Luto
item.description: Luto is a psychological horror experience where you take on the role of someone unable to leave their home. Every attempt to escape will lead you deeper into the unknown, where nothing is as it seems and everything will test your senses.

item.title: Passpartout 2: The Lost Artist
item.description: Embark on your struggling artist adventure. Draw and sell art to cheeky critics to reclaim your lost art career. Explore the endearing art-starved town of Phénix and show them you're a true artist!

item.title: UNDERDOGS
item.description: UNDERGROUND MECH FIGHTS! Wrap yourself in 5 tons of metal & go smashing through a dark scene of full-on metal-on-metal violence!

item.title: BOOK OF HOURS
item.description: Restore a crumbling occult library by a winter sea. Build the world’s foremost collection of grimoires and arcana. Master the invisible arts. BOOK OF HOURS is a narrative crafting RPG set in a 1930s world of hidden gods and secret histories. What sort of Librarian will you choose to be?

item.title: Dead Weight
item.description: Face the Ancient Gods! Set the sails of your flying pirate ship and embark on a roguelite adventure in the steampunk world of Dead Weight. Explore floating islands in search of loot. Choose a class and enjoy turn-based tactical combat on tiny battlefields where every step matters.

item.title: Detective Grimoire
item.description: Detective Grimoire has been called to investigate a murder. The owner of a small tourist attraction, seemingly killed by the mythical creature his attraction is based around... Explore the area, inspect the crime scene, grill suspects, solve puzzles, hunt for clues & uncover the secret of the swamp!

item.title: Diggin
item.description: Drill into the depths of a meteor crater in this incremental adventure. Mine ores, unlock upgrades and find the cosmic treasure that lies below! Can you uncover what happened to the Moles that came before you?

item.title: F1® 25
item.description: Rewrite The Grid with the ultimate evolution in racing: EA SPORTS™ F1® 25: 2026 Season Edition. Get F1® 25 and the 2026 Season Pack in one bundle for the most complete Formula One® experience.

item.title: Funnel Runners
item.description: Trapped in a doomed city, you and up to 7 friends must scavenge parts, fix your van, and escape the brutal tornado that approaches. A first-person co-op survival game with escalating disasters and total environmental destruction.

item.title: GROUND BRANCH
item.description: From one of the developers behind the original Rainbow Six® and Ghost Recon® games, comes a thinking-man's first-person shooter featuring in-depth character and weapon customization. Take your time. Think ahead. Get the job done.

item.title: K-pop Idol Stories: Road to Debut
item.description: The ultimate crossover between K-pop and Life Simulation! Step into the role of manager and build your dream idol group by scouting talent, managing schedules, choosing outfits, planning social media, and organizing the perfect album. Can you make it to debut?

item.title: Looking For Fael
item.description: Hello, this is Fael... Listen, this is going to sound strange, but... I think I'm lost in the apartment. Right now... I... I don't know where I am. Can you come and help me?

item.title: Moss: The Forgotten Relic
item.description: Moss: The Forgotten Relic is an emotional and atmospheric adventure set in the pages of a living storybook, brimming with myth and ancient magic. Guide a tiny but determined hero on a heartfelt journey of challenge, courage, and connection.

item.title: PowerWash Simulator 2 - Adventure Time Pack
item.description: What time is it?! The new Adventure Time Pack is set to bring the Ooo to PowerWash Simulator TwOoo. Grab your friends and blast away grime from distant lands or clean up the wreckage of the world as a solo adventurer in five jobs from the world of Adventure Time – the fun will never end!

item.title: Storebound
item.description: A 1-3 player co-op puzzle horror game set in an accursed megastore. Work together to decode the store's twisted logic, and find a way out before the lurking horrors doom you to shop forever.

item.title: The Mermaid Mask
item.description: An impossible locked-room murder: Captain Mortuga lies dead beside an ancient cauldron aboard the world’s strangest submarine, crewed by sketchy suspects. A handcrafted point-and-click with sharp humour and tricky puzzles. Dive into the next mystery from the creators of Tangle Tower & Crow Country.

item.title: The NOexistenceN of Lilith
item.description: Lilith has returned from the fantasy world to become your desktop companion. Watch her wander freely across your screen with lively animations and dynamic real-time behaviors. Spend cozy everyday moments together as she keeps you company and eases the stress of daily life.

item.title: Tung Tung Tung Survival
item.description: Tung Tung Tung Survival is a first-person single-player survival horror experience set across a dense, isolated 1km × 1km island. Search every corner for the scattered parts you need to repair your boat and escape. But you are not alone. You were never alone.

item.title: Welcome to the Game III
item.description: Navigate the internet's dark net, searching for pieces of a puzzle that once combined will clear your outstanding debt. Scan strange websites for info, hack into PCs while defending your own, and buy/sell goods & services, all while avoiding threats in this strategic, suspenseful horror game.

item.title: Farlands
item.description: Congratulations, you’ve bought your own planet! An agrarian rock at the edge of the galaxy that, for some reason, was practically being given away for free. So the time has come to leave your hectic, stressful life in an overcrowded metropolis for a more rural and rewarding life.

item.title: Farm Factory Simulator
item.description: Grow crops, automate production, and manage your own store. Turn fresh harvests into valuable products and create a wide range of goods. Optimize your workflow with efficient production chains and smart business decisions. Expand your facilities and build the fully automated farm-to-market business.

item.title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult
item.description: The original cooking horror returns in an unhinged co-op experience for 1-4 players. Grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. When Asset Joy begins her hunt, try to escape alive and extract your hard-earned cash to survive another shift.

item.title: Ore Factory Squad ⛏️
item.description: Ore Factory Squad is a co-op mining and factory-building game with procedural mining and fun at its core! Play alone or with friends, buy properties, dig deep for valuable resources, complete contracts, upgrade and automate production lines and grow your factory from zero to industry!

item.title: Pathogenic
item.description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

item.title: SNK HEROINES Tag Team Frenzy
item.description: Take control of SNK’s most iconic female characters and battle it out in this crazy tag fighting game featuring a plethora of cute costumes and accessories! With one button special moves and a deep but simplified combo system this is a great game for fighting game fans and newcomers alike!

item.title: SNK VS. CAPCOM SVC CHAOS
item.description: SNK and CAPCOM legends clash in this star-studded crossover fighting game! The 2003 arcade hit SVC CHAOS is back and better than ever!

item.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XV
item.description: SHATTER ALL EXPECTATIONS! Transcend beyond your limits with KOF XV!

item.title: Catch Me!
item.description: Compete online against your friends and other players in this chaotic and fast paced 4-player game of tag! Race across different locations, jump through windows, electrocute the other players, or throw cats at them. (No cats were harmed in the production of this game.)

item.title: The Mound: Omen of Cthulhu – Lost Explorers' Swords Pack
item.description: Enhance your armory with the Lost Explorers' Swords Pack and unlock two exclusive looks before heading out on expedition.
